title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of a single circle centered at coordinates (0.0032, 0.0032) with a radius of 0.0032. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0064. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it using the same vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting cylindrical base has a length and width of 0.0064285714285714285 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch
circle_center = (0.0032, 0.0032)
circle_radius = 0.0032
sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rod
extrude_depth = 0.75
rod = sketch.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model
r = rod

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0032, 0.0032)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0032)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
